text: 记者18日从中国科学院近代物理研究所获悉，在2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议期间，中国首创的人工智能赋能加速器驱动先进核能系统(AI for ADANES)技术路线面向全球首发，其全域创新联盟同步揭牌成立。据介绍，该技术路线通过搭建物理本征世界模型智能体系，首创“数据+物理模型+专家经验三重驱动”全新范式，破解了AI“黑箱不可控”与核工业“安全零容错”的核心矛盾，填补了全球先进核能智能化落地的技术空白。（中新网）
text_en: Reporters learned from the Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences on the 18th that during the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, a pioneering Chinese technology route — AI-empowered Accelerator-Driven Advanced Nuclear Energy System (AI for ADANES) — was unveiled globally, with its global innovation alliance inaugurated. According to the introduction, this technology route, by building an intelligent system of a physical intrinsic world model, pioneers a new paradigm driven by 'data + physical models + expert experience,' resolving the core contradiction between 'uncontrollable black-box' AI and the 'zero-error tolerance' nuclear industry, filling a global technology gap in the intelligent deployment of advanced nuclear energy. (China News Service)
